remarks: 2939 64 Street SW offers thoughtfully designed living space by San Rufo Homes in the Mattson community of Edmonton. This 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom detached garage home features a functional layout ideal for families and growing households. The main floor includes an open layout with a cozy fireplace anchoring the living area, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The home also includes a side entrance, offering excellent future development potential. Upstairs, all three bedrooms are well-proportioned for comfort and privacy. Located close to parks, pathways, and everyday amenities, this upcoming home blends space, practicality, and contemporary design in a growing southwest Edmonton community. Photos are representative.
